name: theoutlines-growth-skills
description: Claude skills for growth work on mobile subscription apps: screen teardowns across the user journey, plus subscription benchmarks and paywall tools.

plugins.name: growth-skills
plugins.description: Growth teardowns for mobile subscription apps, for product designers: web funnel, onboarding, the onboarding-paywall seam, upsells, the first weeks before renewal and the cancel flow. Each returns a 100-point score for what can be changed on screen (never rewarding pressure), store and dark-pattern flags, a report card and ranked test ideas grounded in published tests and public benchmarks. A router picks the right one. Installs subscription-skills for benchmarks, paywall teardown and store rules.

plugins.name: subscription-skills
plugins.description: Subscription-app monetization toolkit: 2026 benchmark reports (RevenueCat, Adapty, FunnelFox), localized pricing, a benchmark router, an App Store / Google Play paywall compliance review, and Adapty's paywall teardown and A/B test assistant.
